Name: Forces of Light - Rasmodius Aesthetic Overhaul
Author: Sinmenon
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/24769ee3d07c3ca9db531ff61b124719/711acd950bd7bdec-01/s540x810/bfc2c9819ae9c8b0ceb058b2a17c6c4a1a653d44.png[/img]﻿[/center]
I wanted a different aesthetic for Rasmodius, something closer to Merlin from the Fate series but I didn't want a complete rewrite or Merlin himself, so I took upon myself to make a design that I enjoyed. I got inspired by Merlin's Camelot & Co. outfit and came up with everything else myself.
I might make it to be compatible with one of the datable Rasmodius, but for now I'm somewhat happy with the results.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/d20f90559b57f802f4c166372708d0ec/1f5e7dfca36de4fd-8e/s75x75_c1/472af428a2c00aa8327b4ff56c202f41f2b3fc7f.png[/img] [size=2][b]The portrait was created using the [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url] by jazzybee[/b][/size]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/4293845843a73c75dd1e9a6e8ad89d81/985399c436e155d0-8c/s540x810/35818af53c2d49b13dd9ff68c0acd5d0c5c965b8.png[/img]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[/list]
Place it in your Stardew Valley/mods/ folder and you are good to go
